pictures.name: KP1-The-Crowd
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. A narrow stone street in a first-century Galilean lakeside town, packed with a pressing crowd in earth-toned robes and headscarves. Far ahead in the crowd, a man in a plain cream cloak with blue-thread tassels at its corners is seen only from behind, his face never visible. In the foreground, a thin woman in her thirties with tired, kind dark eyes, in a faded rust-red shawl over a grey dress, dark hair under the shawl, stands squeezed at the edge of the crowd, looking toward him with longing. Warm afternoon light, blue shade between houses. The woman in the middle. Hopeful, crowded, quiet. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: KP2-Her-Hand
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike textures, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Close view low among the legs and robes of a jostling crowd: a thin woman’s hand, with a faded rust-red shawl sleeve, reaches between the bodies and her fingertips just touch the blue-thread tassel at the corner of a plain cream cloak worn by a man walking away, seen only from behind and cropped at the waist. A soft warm glow seems to rise from the touch. Gold light through the crowd, deep blue shadows. The hand and tassel in the middle of the frame. Tender, brave, sacred. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: KP3-Who-Touched-Me
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. On the crowded street, the man in the plain cream cloak with blue-thread tassels has stopped and is turning to look around, seen from behind over his shoulder so his face is never visible. Beside him, a burly fisherman with a short dark beard in a brown tunic spreads his hands at the pressing crowd, puzzled. Faces in the crowd look at each other. Half hidden at the side, the thin woman in a faded rust-red shawl over a grey dress clutches the shawl to her chest, eyes wide. Gold light, deep blue shade. The stopped figure in the middle. Suspense, hush. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: KP4-She-Kneels
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. The crowd has opened into a circle on the stone street. The thin woman in her thirties in a faded rust-red shawl over a grey dress, dark hair under the shawl, kneels on the stones, trembling, her face lifted and wet with tears, her hands open as she speaks. Before her stands the man in the plain cream cloak with blue-thread tassels, seen only from behind, his face never visible. The onlookers watch in silence. Warm gold light falling on her face, deep blue shadows around. The kneeling woman in the middle. Honest, vulnerable, holy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: KP5-Go-In-Peace
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. The man in the plain cream cloak with blue-thread tassels, seen from behind, bends down and gently takes the hands of the woman in the faded rust-red shawl, raising her from her knees; his face is never visible. Her face, lit with gold light, has changed from fear to radiant peace and a first smile, healthier now. Soft golden light floods the street, the crowd blurred and warm behind. Her face in the middle of the frame. Peaceful, restoring, joyful. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: KP6-Today-Home-Altar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style, lifelike textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold candlelight, of a modern scene today: a small home altar on a wooden dresser in a modern family living room at evening. On an embroidered cloth: a small crucifix with a dried palm frond tucked behind it, a wooden rosary, a small bottle of holy water, a silver saint’s medal on a chain, a lit candle in red glass, a small statue of Mary in blue, and framed photos of a smiling grandmother and grandfather. Warm gold candlelight, the room softly dark blue around it. The altar in the middle. Loving, remembered, home. No text, no letters, no logos, no readable writing on the bottle.
